decks.notes: The deck revolves around utilizing cards like Underworld Breach, Brain Freeze, and Tinker to set up powerful combo plays. By leveraging artifact and mana acceleration like Black Lotus and Moxen, along with powerful card draw and control options like Ancestral Recall and Force of Will, the deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces for a decisive victory. The inclusion of cards like Narset, Parter of Veils and gifts Ungiven provides additional value and disruption to help secure the win. The deck's strategy relies on speed, efficient card selection, and decisive combo execution.

The main goal of this deck is to quickly assemble the Doomsday combo, which involves casting Doomsday and then using cards like Thassa's Oracle and Street Wraith to win the game in a single turn. The deck includes multiple ways to protect the combo, such as Force of Will and Flusterstorm, and also features card draw and tutors to help find the necessary pieces. The inclusion of disruption spells like Mental Misstep and Demonic Consultation allows the deck to control the game and protect its win condition efficiently.

The deck focuses on using powerful artifacts like The One Ring and Coveted Jewel to generate mana and draw cards, while also utilizing cards like Time Vault and Tinker to assemble game-winning combos. It aims to quickly ramp up mana using mana-producing artifacts and lands like Mishra's Workshop, Ancient Tomb, and Mana Crypt, and protect its pieces with counterspells like Force of Will. The deck also includes cards like Urza's Saga and Karn, the Great Creator to find key artifacts and disrupt opponents' strategies.

The main focus of this combo - Doomsday deck is to quickly and efficiently assemble the cards needed to cast Doomsday, which allows the player to rearrange their deck in a way that ensures victory. The deck includes various powerful spells such as Force of Will, Dark Ritual, and Demonic Tutor to help the player set up their win condition. By carefully planning and executing the Doomsday combo, the player can manipulate their deck to guarantee a successful outcome using cards like Thassa's Oracle and Demonic Consultation.

The deck focuses on assembling key artifacts like Coveted Jewel and Time Vault to generate massive amounts of mana and draw cards with Paradoxical Outcome. It uses powerful mana sources like Mishra's Workshop and Ancient Tomb to quickly ramp up and play multiple spells in one turn. The deck also includes disruptive cards like Trinisphere and Force of Will to protect its combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The goal is to assemble the combo pieces and generate a strong advantage to win the game quickly.

The main concept of this deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan by deploying hatebears like Anointed Peacekeeper, Archon of Emeria, and Chancellor of the Annex while also applying pressure with aggro creatures like White Plume Adventurer and Witch Enchanter. The deck aims to slow down the opponent's plays with cards like Strip Mine and Wasteland, while utilizing fast mana acceleration from cards like Chrome Mox and Moxen to quickly establish control of the game. The inclusion of Seasoned Dungeoneer and Vexing Bauble allows for card advantage and manipulation, giving the deck multiple avenues to victory.

The deck focuses on using Oath of Druids as a key card to cheat powerful creatures like Atraxa, Grand Unifier into play quickly. It also includes control elements such as counterspells (Force of Will), disruption spells (Thoughtseize), and powerful planeswalkers (Oko, Thief of Crowns) to control the game and protect the combo. The deck also includes mana acceleration (Moxen, Mana Crypt) to quickly ramp into its powerful threats. The goal is to disrupt the opponent's game plan while establishing a dominant board presence with the creatures summoned by Oath of Druids.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game using powerful cards like Show and Tell, Oath of Druids, and Bolas's Citadel to quickly assemble a win condition. By disrupting the opponent with counter spells like Force of Will and Flusterstorm, utilizing powerful tutors like Demonic Tutor and Vampiric Tutor, and generating card advantage with cards like Ancestral Recall and Brainstorm, the deck aims to outpace and outmaneuver the opponent in a quick and decisive victory.

The deck is focused on assembling a quick and efficient combo using Doomsday to set up a win condition with Thassa's Oracle. It includes powerful draw spells, counterspells, and rituals to help dig through the deck and protect the combo. The combination of cantrips, tutor effects, and game-winning cards allows the deck to quickly and consistently execute its strategy, making it a strong contender in Vintage 1 vs 1 matches.

This Dimir Control deck relies on powerful spells like Ancestral Recall, Time Walk, and Dig Through Time to control the game and disrupt the opponent's strategy. Utilizing key artifact cards like Black Lotus, Mox Sapphire, and Time Vault, the deck aims to generate advantage and lock down the opponent's options. Wasteland and Strip Mine keep the opponent's mana in check, while cards like Force of Will and Spell Pierce provide protection and disruption. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion allows for additional value and recurring threats, making this deck a formidable force in a Vintage 1 vs 1 format.

The deck focuses on aggressively using Hatebears, including cards like Archon of Emeria and Chancellor of the Annex, to disrupt the opponent's game plan while utilizing cards like Cavern of Souls to protect them. The deck also includes powerful artifacts like Black Lotus and Moxen to ramp into threats quickly. The inclusion of disruptive cards like Wasteland and Karakas further emphasizes the strategy of hindering the opponent's progress. The deck aims to apply pressure while preventing the opponent from effectively developing their board and ultimately achieving victory through a combination of disruption and efficient beatdowns.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly outpace the opponent with aggressive plays while also maintaining control over the game through disruption and card advantage. This Azorius Tempo deck utilizes efficient creatures like White Plume Adventurer and Seasoned Dungeoneer, along with powerful counter spells like Force of Will and Force of Negation, to maintain tempo and pressure the opponent. The deck also has powerful card selection and manipulation with cards like Ancestral Recall and Brainstorm, allowing the player to find the right answers at the right time. Overall, the deck aims to win the game quickly while keeping the opponent on the back foot.

This deck focuses on utilizing artifact creatures and disruptive artifacts to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive threats and resource denial. By using cards like Golos, Tireless Pilgrim, Stonecoil Serpent, and Patchwork Automaton, along with powerful artifact lands like Mishra's Workshop and Ancient Tomb, the deck aims to quickly establish a dominant board presence. The inclusion of cards like Null Rod, Sphere of Resistance, and Trinisphere further disrupt the opponent's game plan, making it difficult for them to respond effectively. The deck also benefits from recursion with Crucible of Worlds, allowing for continuous land destruction with cards like Wasteland.

This deck is focused on utilizing powerful artifact cards such as Time Vault and the Moxen to quickly generate mana and tempo advantage. It also incorporates strong blue spells like Force of Will and Ponder to control the game and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The inclusion of Hullbreacher and White Plume Adventurer further enhances the disruptive elements of the deck, allowing for aggressive plays while maintaining control over the game. The deck is designed to quickly overwhelm the opponent with efficient and versatile threats while maintaining control of the game tempo.

The main focus of this deck is to disrupt your opponent's game plan with hatebears like Anointed Peacekeeper and Archon of Emeria, while also applying pressure with aggressive creatures like White Plume Adventurer. Using disruptive lands like Wasteland and Karakas, as well as tax effects from cards like Chancellor of the Annex, this deck aims to slow down the opponent's strategy and outvalue them with powerful creatures. The deck also includes some mana acceleration from Moxen and ramp spells like Seasoned Dungeoneer to quickly deploy threats and overpower the opponent.

This deck focuses on leveraging powerful artifacts and fast mana sources to generate large amounts of mana quickly, enabling the player to cast game-winning spells like Tinker and Paradoxical Outcome. The deck aims to assemble key artifact combos, such as using Time Vault with either Voltaic Key or Manifold Key, to create an advantage. The inclusion of disruptive spells like Force of Will and Trinisphere helps control the game and protect the combo pieces. The deck also utilizes card draw and manipulation effects like Sensei's Divining Top and Mystic Forge to ensure consistency in executing its strategy.
